avviso: Free prediction game, no betting and no cash prizes

home.titolo: Predict beach tennis with your friends.
home.intro: Pick the winner, the set scores and the long tie-break of ITF events. Points land on their own after each match, and every month starts from zero.
home.nessunaAperta: No matches to predict right now. Come back when the next round is out.
home.ciaoSotto: Who wins today, in your opinion?
home.passo1: Pick the winner and how the sets end: 6-4, 7-5… and the long tie-break if it goes to three.
home.passo2: After the match you get up to 14 points. Even a near miss scores something.
home.passo3: Start a league with your club friends and find out who really knows the game.

partita.puoiCambiare: You can change it until the match starts.
partita.superTieBreak: The third set (super tie-break) goes to {nome}.
partita.inPalio: Up to {massimo} points: {vincitore} for the winner, {set} for the sets, up to {game} for games, and +{esatto} if the score is exact (off by just one: +{quasi}).
partita.notaSuperTieBreak: The super tie-break counts as 1 game for whoever wins it.
partita.notaLong: Long tie-break: first to 10 with a 2-point lead; past 10 it goes on until someone leads by 2 (up to 50). It counts as 1 game in total games.
partita.notaSet: Use the arrows for each set's games (6-0…6-4, 7-5, 7-6). If the sets are split, the long tie-break appears.
partita.setNonValido: Set {n} can't end like that: it's 6-0…6-4, or 7-5 or 7-6.
partita.longNonValido: The long is won at 10 with a 2-point lead (past 10, exactly 2).
partita.vinceAltra: With this score {nome} win: change the numbers or your pick.

regole.partita: Match, up to {massimo} points. Pick the winner and write each set's score; if the sets are split, also the long tie-break, which counts as 1 game for its winner. Right winner +{vincitore}. Exact set score (2-0 or 2-1) +{set}. Total games: errors on both pairs are added up and you get {scala} points (error→points); beyond {oltre}, nothing. Exact score (every set and the long) +{esatto}; off by just one (a game or a point) +{quasi}.
regole.torneo: Tournament: winner {vincitore} points, finalist {finalista}, weighted by how many picked them (from half to two and a half times).
regole.blocco: Predictions close when the match or tournament starts. Vote percentages are shown only after closing.

classifica.legenda: Picks = predictions · Win. = winners guessed · Sets = exact set scores · Games = exact games. Ties are broken by exact sets, then winners, then exact games.

privacy.testo: Beach Peck stores only the data the game needs: email (to sign in), nickname, country, language, your predictions, leagues and the days you use the app (to count active users). We don't sell or share data and we don't use profiling cookies: only technical cookies for sign-in and language. You can delete your account and all your data at any time from your profile.
